QUESTIONS

Common questions.

Who can participate?+

EcoThon is open to all departments. CADathon is only for Civil Engineering students.

Can we choose our own problem?+

No. Both themes use problems given at the event.

Which software should I install?+

For CADathon, pre-install your planning, design and analysis software. Ask a coordinator about accepted software.

What is the team size and fee basis?+

Contact a coordinator to confirm team size, fee basis and the registration deadline.

Will food be provided?+

Yes. Lunch and refreshments are included.
